description: Na₃SbS₄O₉ crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.51 Å) and three longer (2.54 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.28 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.36 Å. Sb is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one S and three equivalent O atoms. The Sb-S bond length is 2.24 Å. All Sb-O bond lengths are 1.97 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Sb atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.75 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Sb and one S atom.
